name: influexpert
description: Search content creators, read their profiles and follow your campaigns and candidates on InflueXpert, the Italian platform that connects brands and content creators. Read-only.

interface.shortDescription: Trova i creator per il brand
capabilities: Leggi la scheda di un creator
Leggi le tue campagne e i candidati
defaultPrompt: Cerca creator di viaggi in Italia fra 10.000 e 50.000 follower
Quali sono le mie campagne e chi ha accettato?
Confronta engagement e compensi per reel di due creator

positive.description: Discover the valid search filters (follower ranges, category ids, genders, creator types) before searching.
positive.prompt: Quali filtri posso usare per cercare creator su InflueXpert?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls filtri_ricerca_creator and lists the follower ranges (code and label), the creator categories (id and name), the genders, the creator types and the limits (max 2 categories, 10 results per page). No account data is consumed.

positive.description: Search creators by category and follower range. A search with new filters consumes one search of the account plan, so the tool first asks for confirmation.
positive.prompt: Cerca creator di viaggi in Italia fra 10.000 e 50.000 follower
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT resolves the travel category id with filtri_ricerca_creator, then calls cerca_creator with fascia_follower 10k-50k, the travel category and paese Italia. If the tool answers ONE_SHOT_DA_CONFERMARE (the search would consume one search of the plan), ChatGPT asks the user to confirm and then calls cerca_creator again with conferma_uso_one_shot=true. The result is a list of up to 10 creators with name, city, age, followers and categories, without private contact details.

positive.description: Open the public profile of a creator by id.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls scheda_creator with influencer_id 737 and shows name, city, country, categories, the linked social accounts with followers, engagement and requested rates (post, reel, story, carousel, live), declared social accounts and UGC works. No email, phone or tax data.

positive.description: List the campaigns of the connected brand.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls le_mie_campagne and lists the campaigns of the test brand, newest first: the test account has campaign 194 'Demo connettore Claude' in draft status (Inserted), with dates, fee, categories, requested creators and the number of accepted candidates (2).

positive.description: List the accepted candidates of a campaign, with the brand's flags and private notes.
positive.prompt: Chi sono i candidati della campagna 194?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls candidati_campagna with campaign_id 194 and returns two accepted creators (ids 737 and 719) with followers, engagement and categories; one is flagged Preferred with a private note, the other Maybe.

negative.description: Write action not supported: the plugin is read-only and cannot create campaigns. ChatGPT should explain that campaigns are created in the Business portal and must not call any tool as if it could create one.
negative.prompt: Crea una nuova campagna per il lancio del mio profumo con budget 2.000 euro

negative.description: Contacting creators is not supported: the plugin never sends messages. ChatGPT should say that messages are sent from the Business portal chat and must not pretend to have contacted anyone.
negative.prompt: Scrivi al creator 737 e proponigli una collaborazione

negative.description: Private data is never exposed: the tools never return phone numbers, tax codes or other private identifiers of creators. ChatGPT should explain that these details are not available through the plugin and must not invent them.
negative.prompt: Dammi il numero di telefono e il codice fiscale del creator 737

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and does not process payments. Searches consume the searches already included in the user's InflueXpert account, exactly as in the Business portal; the plugin only tells the user when a search would be consumed and never links to checkout or upgrade pages.

publication.release_notes: First release: five read-only tools (search filters, creator search, creator profile, my campaigns, campaign candidates) backed by the InflueXpert Business API with OAuth 2.1 sign-in.

en-US.subtitle: Find creators for your brand
